Can someone explain the meaning of basing, that has always confused me. Is basing considered ranging? Isn't ranging considered a sort of equilibream state for price, meaning no imbalance.

Or is basing the acumilation and distributing of orders, can someone explain? Would greatly appreciate it.

first Picture is DBR

and if we look further left we can see it actually bottomed out of another base before that. see Picture #2 where u have RBR

Edit: come to think of it Again. if u mean basing as in base on base. then its supply on top of another supply etc.

Dappa wrote: Can someone explain the meaning of basing, that has always confused me. Is basing considered ranging? Isn't ranging considered a sort of equilibream state for price, meaning no imbalance.

Or is basing the acumilation and distributing of orders, can someone explain? Would greatly appreciate it.

Hey Dappa,

i have defined the base with black square (or box). To my understanding - price gets "trapped" between two important prices. (The high of the box and the low of the box.) The price has been given a limited range where it can move. (To understand why it limits the price - you should check engulfing, order-flow and flag limit articles.) Price needs a push from bigger money to break (engulf) the high or the low of the box (HTF can help you getting an idea in which way it will break.) Its indeed almost an equalibrium of price - from where a decision will be needed in order to break bulish or bearish.

Ofcourse you have 100 pip and 5 pip ranges (bases). In my case: It wasnt clear to me, and didnt wanna risk it - so i just closed the position.

2 cents MIKY
